AS DEN NATIONALE SCENE describes itself on its website as: "Den Nationale Scene skaper engasjerende, underholdende og samfunnsrelevant teater. Se program og kjøp billetter".
AS DEN NATIONALE SCENE is a private limited company (AS), founded on 1962-06-29, registered in Bergen.
It has 209 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 383.97M for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 10.21M (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of -2.7% and a moderate equity ratio of 19% of total assets.

Revenue rose 76.5% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 217.55M to NOK 383.97M); it was NOK 193.67M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in 2025, as in 2024 (2023: -NOK 1.38M, 2024: NOK 13.19M, 2025: NOK 13.24M).
AS DEN NATIONALE SCENE is led by CEO Solrun Toft Iversen and board chair Michelle Williams.
It has a board of 7. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-02-02 (within the past year).
AS DEN NATIONALE SCENE has a verified website (https://dns.no/), 3 linked public profiles and 1 registered workplace.
